glosses: to put someone off something; to spoil something for someone

examples.text: Das Rauchverbot hat mir den Kneipenbesuch vollkommen madiggemacht.
examples.translation: The smoking ban has completely put me off going to pubs.
examples.english: The smoking ban has completely put me off going to pubs.

examples.text: Mit deiner schlechten Laune machst du mir den ganzen Urlaub madig.
examples.translation: You're spoiling my whole vacation with your bad mood.
examples.english: You're spoiling my whole vacation with your bad mood.

glosses: to try to talk someone out of something for selfish reasons

examples.text: Mein Freund macht mir immer den Sport madig, damit ich mit ihm ins Kino gehe.
examples.translation: My boyfriend always tries to talk me out of training so that I go to the cinema with him.
examples.english: My boyfriend always tries to talk me out of training so that I go to the cinema with him.
